comments.author: FiveF
comments.body_html:
The eyes position relative to the eyepiece influences the path of refracted light. The exit pupil (the virtual aperture for light exiting an optical system into the eyes pupil), may be smaller when the eye is distant, leading to vignetting and the dark circle effect.

optics, physics, mathematics, engineering, materials science, refraction of light, geometry, trigonometry, index of refraction etc

to put it simply, the sight is mounted too far xd

comments.author: HANAVI

comments.author: Greev
comments.body_html: So I did some testing, it’s apparently a conflict with realism. Not sure what exactly is doing it, but switching the load order around didn’t fix it. comments.author: HANAVI
comments.body_html: I remember SVMs have the same functionality. Why don’t we try SVMs temporarily for now?
